title: Ganatantra Mancha protest rally and march against prices and alleged corruption
location: Jatiya National Press Club to Zero Point near the Secretariat, Dhaka
scope: rally followed by a procession toward a state institution
organizer: Ganatantra Mancha, an alliance of opposition parties
participants_original: No attendance count. Dhaka Tribune quotes an organizer claiming at least 50 people were injured, while The Daily Star reports 40 injuries and police disputes/qualifies the claims; injuries are not turnout.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending. The articles report 40 injured according to Ganatantra Mancha/The Daily Star and at least 50 injured according to an organizer quoted by Dhaka Tribune; police dispute the higher claim. None gives a total attendance count, and an injured-person estimate cannot establish total participant count.

occurrence_and_date.summary: Dhaka Tribune and The Daily Star report the actual rally/procession on Wednesday 28 February 2024.

location.summary: The rally began at the National Press Club and the procession toward the Secretariat was stopped near Zero Point.

organizer_and_scope.summary: Both reports identify Ganatantra Mancha as the alliance organizing the gathering.

demands.summary: Reports identify protests against rising prices/price hikes and money laundering; S001 also reports a demand about restoring voting rights through government removal.

participants_original.summary: Neither report establishes total turnout. Injury claims vary and police dispute the 50-injured claim; do not treat injuries as attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: At least 50 participants is not established. Injury claims (40 and at least 50) are not turnout estimates.

state_response.summary: Reports describe baton charges and obstruction/dispersal. They report a few detentions, with exact count unclear. No other response variables are evidenced.

notes: Dhaka Tribune and The Daily Star provide detailed contemporaneous reports. Financial Express page is explicitly attributed to bdnews24.com and is treated as dependent; its estimates are withheld from coding and are not counted as an independent source. Organizer allegations and police statements remain attributed and contested.
open_questions: What was total turnout, and is there credible evidence it reached at least 50?
Can an event-specific attendance estimate be found from an independent source?
Are there further documented state responses beyond baton charges and unspecified detentions?
